method: Three data-driven renderers, each shown with two content inputs. Only declared viewport, flow, optional-image and auto-height properties change within before/after pairs. Unchanged ordinary inputs serve as controls.

examples.name: template-variable-titles
examples.title: A notice template accommodates short and long titles
examples.description: The short-title notice remains unchanged. In the long-title notice only the title viewport height and the image/details group translation change. All supplied words, font families, sizes, weights, local title baselines, image bytes/crop, colors and paper remain fixed. The before viewport clips the third line; after reveals it and moves subsequent content 44 units. Approved input line breaks are supplied; this is not an automatic line-breaking engine.
examples.presentation: Wide: before set beside after set. Narrow: before/after interleaved by input. Native artifact content and geometry remain identical between the two presentations.

examples.name: template-conditional-offers
examples.title: A conditional offer keeps eligibility next to its price
examples.description: The standard-price notice remains unchanged. In the reduced-price notice only the supplied condition group and booking-address group translations change. Price, condition wording, date, photograph/crop, type, sizes, colors and surface remain fixed. The reduced-price input requires actual supplied eligibility; the template does not infer or invent it.
examples.presentation: Wide: before set beside after set. Narrow: before/after interleaved by input. Native artifact content and geometry remain identical between the two presentations.

examples.name: template-missing-image-and-notes
examples.title: A recurring review handles an absent image and a longer data note
examples.description: The October review remains unchanged. November has no supplied photograph: before shows an inherited October image, after hides it, moves the data/note/reference group up 220 units and reduces both card-surface heights by 220 units. Its note viewport grows from one to three lines. All current values and note words, fonts, sizes, anchors within groups and colors remain fixed; October photographic bytes/crop are unchanged. No new image or data is invented. Paper/card height changes are required by this auto-height digital-card variant.
examples.presentation: Wide: before set beside after set. Narrow: before/after interleaved by input. Native artifact content and geometry remain identical between the two presentations.
